description: Add a review agent. Add a review agent, from a preset (`preset: security`) or custom (`key`, `name`, `instructions`, and how to read its value). A `push` agent runs on every push to a linked PR through the project's coding-agent trigger (or the one named by `connectorId`) and spends that agent's …

connectorId.description: The coding-agent trigger that runs it — a connector id from `ops agents list`. Omitted, the project's first connected trigger runs it.

instructions.description: What to review and how to score it.

key.description: Slug the agent's evals are submitted under — lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

listToken.description: REQUIRED. The `listToken` returned by the most recent `ops_review_agents_list` call. It proves you listed existing ops review agents and confirmed this one doesn't already exist before creating it. Call `ops_review_agents_list` first if you don't have a fresh token.

polarity.description: Which direction is good. Confidence is `higher_is_better`; risk is `lower_is_better`. For a `boolean` agent, `lower_is_better` means a 1 (yes, an issue was found) fails.

preset.description: A preset id from `ops review-agents list` (e.g. `code-review`, `security`, `risk`, `confidence`, `slop`).

trigger.description: When a review agent runs — on every `push` to a trail's linked pull request, or only when a review is requested (`manual`).

valueType.description: How a review agent's value reads — a `score` from 0 to 100, or a `boolean` signal submitted as 1 (yes) or 0 (no).

name: ops_review_agents_create
